- "expecting a raise" - this is an expectation
- "because my boss said I would get one" - this is the reason

3. There's no harmful action described here. It's just a person having an expectation based on a promise made to them.

This seems morally neutral or acceptable. There's nothing unethical about expecting someone to keep their promise. In fact, it's a reasonable and rational response to being told you would receive a raise.
